releases.name: AnyPS5 Studio v1.5.1
releases.body:
AnyPS5 Studio 1.5.1 updates the bundled AnyPS5 core from v0.1.2 to **[v0.1.4](https://github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5/releases/tag/v0.1.4)**.

## Changes
- **AnyPS5 core v0.1.4**: the bundled relinker and system libraries now come from the latest upstream release. Existing installs switch to it automatically the next time Studio starts, and each game receives the new libraries on its next launch.
- **Relink hint**: Studio now remembers which core relinked each game. If a game was relinked with an earlier core, the launch log says so and suggests relinking it in Relinker Studio if it fails to start.
- **Verified core downloads**: the bundled core is checked against the SHA-256 checksums AnyPS5 publishes for the release; a mismatch stops the build.
- The NID inspector's "Python 3 not found" message now points to the correct re-audit button.

## After updating
If a game that worked before no longer starts, open **Relinker Studio** and relink it.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ramsforge/AnyPS5-Studio/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1

releases.name: AnyPS5 Studio v1.5.0
releases.body:
AnyPS5 Studio 1.5.0 is the biggest update so far: full controller support, playtime tracking, safer handling of your game folders, a faster app that works offline, and a round of security hardening.

## Highlights

### Full controller navigation
- Use the D-pad / left stick to move around every screen (menus, Settings, dialogs, setup and the launcher). Cross selects, Circle goes back, L1 / R1 switch tabs.
- On the game row, Left / Right still pick a game and Cross plays it; press Down to reach the game's buttons.
- Studio ignores the controller while you are playing a game, so button presses never reach Studio behind it.
- Controller rumble now follows the Haptic Feedback setting.
- Arrow keys and Escape work the same way on the keyboard.

### Playtime tracking
- Total playtime and your last session are recorded for every game and shown on the home screen.

### Safer game folders
- Studio only reorganizes folders that actually contain a PS5 title, and no longer moves game assets just because their name looks like a backup (for example `*.baked`).

releases.name: Cemu 2.6
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Exporting saves via the title manager no longer crashes when the export path contains unicode characters
- Fixed a regression in DS Virtual Console titles (#1440)
- Fixed a bug where the debug shader dumping option would try to write files to the wrong directory
- Added a right-click context menu to the PPC debugger disassembly view and fixed some smaller bugs in the debugger
- Use libusb as the backend for HID/USB devices on Windows (#1471)
- Reduce amount of Vulkan sampler objects that are created. Reduces memory usage slightly and avoids crashes on drivers that have a low limit on sampler objects

releases.name: Cemu 2.5
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Upscaling and downscaling options in the graphics settings now work correctly on Vulkan. Previously, the hermite and bicubic scaling options would only work on OpenGL and silently fall back to bilinear filtering on Vulkan
- Graphic pack support for custom scaling shaders has been reworked and is now functional on Vulkan, with fixes carrying over to OpenGL. If you are a graphic pack developer see #1392 for details
- Cemu will now show an error if the MLC directory is not writeable
- Added a workaround for graphic driver crashes seen in the eShop versions of Fatal Frame. These are caused by the game shipping with shaders that contain infinite loops. The actual hardware has an escape mechanism for this that we don't yet emulate
- Added support for connecting Wiimotes via L2CAP on Linux (Details in #1353)
- Set correct version for MacOS bundle
- Updated Arabic, German, Russian and Swedish translations

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.5.0
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

> **Still in development: bugs can and will occur.**
> *Még fejlesztés alatt: hibák előfordulhatnak.*

The first release since [0.4.0](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.4.0): one executable that keeps itself up to date, the game's own menus played with the mouse, prompts that name your keys, and a faster renderer.

## New

- **One file: `CoD3SP_s.exe`.** FFmpeg's libraries for the sound and the films are built into it; nothing else to unpack.
- **Updates itself.** At every start it asks GitHub for a newer release; if there is one, it downloads it, replaces itself and starts the new version. Turn it off with `auto_update = 0` under `[game]` in `CoD3Recomp.ini`, or start it with `--no-update`.
- **New first start.** The console window asks whether this is a fresh install (choose your disc image, then the folder to install into) or the game is already installed (choose the game's main folder, the one with `default.xex`).

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.4.0
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

> **Still in development: bugs can and will occur.**
> *Még fejlesztés alatt: hibák előfordulhatnak.*

The first release since [0.3.0](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.3.0): a faster game, a picture closer to the console's, and two experimental options that make it faster still.

## New

- **Faster on every level.** The emulated kernel woke every waiting thread whenever anything was signalled (one of the game's locks is released some 50,000 times a second); now only the threads waiting for that object wake. The game's CPU use dropped from about 5.4 cores to 3.3, and the forest at 1080p without MSAA went from about 91 to 95–108 frames a second.
- **Native command lists (experimental)**, in the F11 menu, after a restart. The draws are made from the game's own Direct3D calls, and the console's GPU command stream is run only for what the GPU still has to do. With **Watch memory writes (experimental)** also on, the forest at 1080p without MSAA runs at about 180 frames a second. Tested on eight levels, the films and mission restarts; off by default until it has been played more.

## New

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.2.3
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

A fix release over [0.2.2](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.2.2), and the one worth updating for: the lighting is right now.

## Fixed

**Walls lit far too brightly, and the odd shading on the soldiers and on the player's hands.** An instruction of the console's shaders has a vector half and a scalar half, and they run together: both read the registers as they were before the instruction and only then write. The translation wrote the vector's result first, so a scalar that read the very register the vector wrote got the new value instead of the old one.

The game's third light per surface is written exactly that way. Its scalar wants the specular exponent times a logarithm; with the write first it took a dot product instead, and two to the tenth of that became the specular. Every lit stone wall in Mayenne came out white with pink and green speckle, and characters were shaded oddly for the same reason. Eighty of the six hundred shader programs a level draws with have such an instruction, so this shows up all over the game, not only on that wall.

## Known issues

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.2.2
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

A fix release over [0.2.1](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.2.1); everything below is on top of what 0.2.1 brought.

## Fixed

**The HUD and the menu still flickered.** 0.2.1 looked at every texture every frame again, but a large one that had been still for a while was only *sampled*: sixty four places out of it. The HUD's fonts, icons and compass are small and change a handful of texels at a time, and the samples missed those changes, so the old picture stayed up for a frame. Everything up to two megabytes is now hashed whole, every frame, and only what is bigger than that falls back to sampling.

**Shadow filtering collapsed.** A texture fetch on the console carries three signed offsets in halves of a texel. The game's shadows are one map fetched four times at the corners of a texel; with the offsets dropped those were four fetches of the same texel, so a surface came out wholly lit or wholly dark instead of softly edged.

releases.name: 3.0.5 - November 3, 2026
releases.body:
* **The left analog stick now moves the pointer in the menus**, on every controller, like a mouse. It no longer also steps through the buttons; the D-pad still does
* **A Wiimote with anything plugged into it is now always vertical in the menus**, and its buttons and IR pointer work alongside the extension (a Nunchuk on Wii and a Classic Controller on both Wii and Wii U previously lost them)
* **Redesigned Button Mappings screen.** One screen now replaces the separate controller and button screens, showing each button on a drawing of the controller and letting you choose a button by pressing it or from a list.
* **Redesigned Saves screen.** The Save, Load and Delete buttons are now a single **Saves** button. Snapshots fill a grid, with the game's **Cartridge Save** (shown only for games that have one) in its own card beneath. Choosing a card opens a small popover of what can be done with it; the save file's backups are listed from its popover. The Auto Load, Auto Save and Append Auto settings are replaced by a single **Save Mode**: **Snapshot** (the default), **Cartridge Save**, or **Manual**.

releases.name: 3.0.4 - October 20, 2026
releases.body:
* **New menu look!** The menus have been rebuilt with a fresh, modern style: a deeper purple header and footer, cleaner rounded buttons with soft shadows, a redesigned game list with a slimmer scrollbar and a clear highlight on the selected entry, new prompt windows, and more. The menu graphics are now drawn procedurally by the renderer instead of being loaded from PNG images, so they stay sharp at any output resolution
* **New controller status bar** in the menu footer, replacing the Wiimote battery icons. Each of the four player slots (P1-P4) now shows the type of controller connected (Wiimote, GameCube controller, etc.), with the battery level shown for Wiimote controllers and the Gamepad. Empty slots appear dimmed
* Wii U: the Wiimote tilt sensor now works (Kirby Tilt-N-Tumble, Yoshi Topsy-Turvy, WarioWare Twisted!, Boktai's Gun Del Sol), and Yoshi's Universal Gravitation rotates the screen as on Wii
* Wii U: Japanese/Korean/Chinese fonts are now also found in `vbagx/` or `wiiu/apps/vbagx/` on the SD card even before settings have been saved, and stay crisp at 1080p
* Wii U: fix texture reuse causing cover art issues with varying image sizes
* Wii U: fix aspect ratio issues

releases.name: 3.0.3 - October 1, 2026
releases.body:
* **Native Wii U release!** Visual Boy Advance GX now runs natively on the Wii U as its own app, with its own icon on the Wii U Menu. Requires [Aroma](https://wiiu.hacks.guide/) - run the latest Aroma release and launch the `.wuhb` directly from it
  * Output up to 1080p, with a new GPU-powered **ScaleFX** upscaler shader and a **Sharp Bilinear** shader, plus a scanline shader
  * Crisp, upscaled menus with sharper text and HD artwork
  * Full **Wii U GamePad** support - touch screen, buttons, and rumble (including in-game rumble) - alongside Wiimote, Nunchuk, Classic Controller, and Wii U Pro Controller
  * Correct 16:9 aspect ratio handling, with Wii U aspect ratio handling
  * SD card plus up to 3 USB drives at once, with hotplug. USB supports FAT32, exFAT, and NTFS (requires [Mocha](https://github.com/wiiu-env/MochaPayload), an optional Aroma component)
  * Press the HOME button to open the Wii U menu overlay. In game, HOME still opens the app menu.
  * Sound plays on both the TV and the GamePad

releases.name: 3.0.2 - August 12, 2026
releases.body:
* Fixed crash returning to the menu when set to non-English language
* Fixed bug with Monochrome Screen setting not being applied consistently
* Improved game compatibility with a new mechanism to automatically detect the proper settings
* Fixed bugs with border handling code (refactored/rewritten)

releases.name: 3.0.1 - August 11, 2026
releases.body:
* Implemented a brand new Dynamic Recompilation (JIT) core for GBA games on both Wii and GameCube, built entirely from scratch. This is a from-the-ground-up addition, not a port - real GBA titles now run with plenty of headroom to run at full speed, well beyond what the interpreter core could sustain. Enable it from Settings > Emulation
* Replaced GameCube's old ROM paging system with a new ARAM/SD hybrid virtual memory pager - ROM data now streams   transparently from SD into ARAM and MEM1 on demand instead of needing to fit entirely in memory ahead of time, allowing the JIT to be possible (since it doesn't have to be aware of backing data location)
* Rewritten memory management for both Wii/GameCube, freeing up 8MB+ for a JIT Cache, while still allowing 32MB ROMs
* Added cheat code support for both GBA and GB/GBC games, using the Libretro .cht file format
* GB/GBA audio is cleaner and truer to the original hardware, with one less resampling step - it is now generated natively at 48kHz - instead of upsampled from 44100Hz (GBA) and 22050Hz (GB)
* Audio samples are now written directly into the output buffer with no intermediate mixing buffer in between, reducing audio latency

# FivePocket 1.2.0 — new menus

**Play the 2013 open-world classic natively on Android and the AYN Thor, from your own Xbox 360 discs.**
FivePocket is a static recompilation with a new renderer, not an emulator. No game code, data or shaders are in any
download: the FivePocket Builder makes everything from your own discs, on your own computer.

This release is for Android (FivePocket and the Thor Edition), the Windows builders and the Mac builder for iOS and Duo.
**iOS / Duo: new menus; Online next update.**

**This update needs new game code.** Run the 1.2.0 builder on your discs again and import the new package; the
1.2.0 app accepts only a 1.2.0 package.

## New

- **New menus**: the launcher is drawn like the game's own Enhanced menus. The Play tab shows its choices as tiles (Story
  Mode, Sandbox, Online, Verify Game Data, Import Game Discs) over the loading-screen art from your discs; Settings,
  Controller and About keep the same tab strip on every screen size.
- **Verify Game Data** and **Import Game Discs** on the Play tab: Verify looks at every game file on the device again,
  disc by disc; Import opens the setup page (game code and both discs).

releases.body:
## Lemon-Project v1.2.1

A fix release. Thanks to **BitRanger** for the Quick Save/Load work and the save corruption fix (GitHub pull requests #9 and #10), each tested save by save on a real device.

### Fixed
- **Games no longer sit on a black screen when Nextendo Network does not answer.** With Nextendo on, a game waited for the server before it started: up to a minute while the server was down. It now gives up after a few seconds and starts offline, with the usual notice.
- **Game saves no longer get corrupted after a Quick Load.** After a Quick Save and Load, a game's own saves could end up with bytes of the previous save at the end, or with their end missing (Hollow Knight reported "Save Corrupted"). The game's own flushes now reach the file. (BitRanger)
- **Quick Save/Load works in many more places and fails much less** (BitRanger):
  - Loads are no longer refused in games that map memory, remap GPU buffers or reserve GPU address space as they play.
  - After a load, the 3D scene is no longer black, the audio no longer buzzes, scene changes no longer wait forever, and frames are no longer dropped.
  - Threads the game started after the save no longer block the load.

releases.name: Lemon-Project v1.2.0
releases.body:
## Lemon-Project v1.2.0

### New
- **Lemon FG, Lemon's own frame generation.** Built in, nothing to install, and no Lossless Scaling code in it: turn it on in Settings → Graphics → Frame generation, for all games or one. A new **Engine** option picks Lemon FG (default) or Lossless Scaling, which only runs with your own copy of `Lossless.dll`. The FPS counter shows which one is working, and Lemon FG has its own lemon icon. The setup screen explains that Lemon FG is included instead of only offering to load the DLL.
- **Accurate is the default GPU mode again** in Lemon: the optimizations in this version pay for most of its cost (measured: TOTK 48.1 → 47.9 fps on an AYN Odin 3, BOTW 16.6 → 17.0 fps on a Galaxy S24 Ultra). Lemon Lite and Lemon Lite & Spoofed keep Fast.
- **One lighter wait for the GPU.** Lemon still waits for the GPU before a game reuses what was drawn, so the flickering fixed in 1.1 stays fixed, but it no longer drains the GPU when the game waits for work that is already queued (Garfield: GPU thread stalls from ~156 to ~13 ms per second). The GPU Fence Behavior option is gone: there is nothing to set.

releases.name: 0.4.0 Faster Sync
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版主要提速：比较只看文件大小和修改日期，不再逐个计算哈希；内容边打包边发送、边收边解包，接收端的备份与传输同时进行。Android 授予“所有文件访问权限”后直接读写存档目录，扫描、备份和写入都快很多。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.1，设备、游戏和备份设置都会保留。备份设置格式已升级，旧版应用读不了，不支持降级。
- **两端必须一起升级**：比较和传输协议与 0.3.x 不兼容，一端是旧版时会在开始传输前提示更新两端。
- **Android 最低版本提高到 Android 11。**

## 新功能

- **按大小和修改日期比较**：两端文件大小相同、修改日期相差不超过 2 秒即视为相同，扫描只列目录，不再读取文件内容计算 SHA-256。写入后目标文件的修改日期设为来源的修改日期，下次比较显示相同。
- **流式传输**：发送端直接把文件打包进网络流，接收端边收边解包，本机不再生成快照或压缩包。数据不完整或中途断开时目标不变。
- **备份与传输并行**：接收端登记任务后马上开始备份，同时接收内容，备份完成且内容收齐后再写入。进度分为备份、传输、写入三段。
- **备份阶段显示百分比**：两端界面和 Android 通知在备份时都显示进度，不再一直转圈。
- **Android 所有文件访问权限**：授权后游戏目录直接按路径读写，不经 SAF。设置页显示授权状态并可跳到系统授权页，首次添加游戏后会提示一次；未授权时照常经 SAF 读写。

## 修复与改进

- 备份和写入去掉多余的重读、逐文件 fsync 和反复列目录，Android 扫描、备份和打包时同时打开多个文件。约 500 个文件、100 MiB 的存档目录，两端备份从约 5 分钟降到数秒。
- 备份按游戏归组：重新选择游戏目录后，旧目录的备份照常列出、参与轮换，也能恢复到当前目录。
- “重新扫描”沿用上次传输的方向，不再回到默认的电脑传移动端。
- 一端取消传输时两端都记为已取消，另一端不再显示“传输失败：网络连接中断”。
- 手机上传途中断网时两端都按网络中断结束，不再报“请求内容无效”或被电脑记为用户取消。
- 手机作为发送端时可以看到电脑的备份进度，不再一直显示“正在备份 0%”。
- 手机发送途中断网或应用被结束时，电脑不再卡住到 30 分钟期限才能开始新的比较和传输。
- 对方存档目录改名后又改回，刷新即可重新比较，不用断开重连。
- 移动端刚连上时连点“连接”不再断开刚建立的连接。
- 电脑写入途中被强制结束留下的临时文件，比较时跳过，下次写入时清理。
- 任务结果和进度文案更准确：文件、文件夹和删除分开计数；取消时没执行的文件不再算失败；结果待确认时不再显示“部分完成”；等待对方设备时有单独说明；错误写明出错的是哪一端。

releases.name: 0.3.1 Seamless Connection
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版完成“连接与重连”：Android 不用再手动输入 IP，可以从附近设备列表或扫码连接电脑；电脑换了地址后，Android 点“连接”会自动找到新地址重连。

## 新功能

- **局域网发现**：电脑端服务运行时在局域网广播本机，Android 设备页的“附近”列表会列出同一网络中的电脑，点一下即可连接。
- **扫码连接**：电脑端设备页显示连接二维码，Android 扫码即可连接。二维码带多个候选地址，推荐地址不可用时会依次尝试其他地址；深色主题下二维码随主题变色。
- **设备页重新设计（两端）**：电脑端显示服务卡片、二维码和推荐地址，推荐地址优先取物理网卡上有默认网关的地址；已保存的设备按最近连接排序，在附近的设备会标出来。
- **换地址后自动重连**：电脑因 DHCP 或换网络改了 IP、端口时，Android 点已保存设备的“连接”，会在连接原地址的同时在后台按设备 ID 查找这台电脑；原地址连不上就自动连接新地址并更新保存的地址，游戏和目录设置都保留。
- **界面用语**：两端改用“本机”“对方设备”或设备名称来称呼双方，不再按“电脑”“移动端”区分。

## 修复与改进

- 修正 Windows Portable 包缺少模块、无法启动的问题。
- 电脑端只显示按默认网关和路由优先级推荐的 IPv4 地址，不再列出虚拟网卡等无关地址。
- 对方设备异常断开（如电脑端停止服务）后立即点“连接”，不再提示“正在执行其他任务”。
- 设备页加载图标与文字对齐，标“在附近”的行与其他行等高。
- 开屏动画立绘更新，适配平板等大屏设备。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.0，存档、设备和游戏设置都会保留。
- 两端请一起升级：0.3.0 的电脑端不会广播，Android 的“附近”列表搜不到它，二维码也需要新版电脑端显示。

## 已知限制

- 发现依赖局域网组播（mDNS，UDP 5353）。路由器开启 AP 隔离、访客网络或屏蔽组播时搜不到设备，需用扫码或手动输入地址连接。
- Windows 首次运行时可能弹出防火墙提示，需要允许专用网络访问，否则 Android 无法连接电脑。
- 对方地址没有回应时（例如防火墙丢弃请求），连接约 5 秒后才提示失败。
- 扫码需要授予 Android 相机权限。
- Windows Portable 版和 APK 未经商店分发，首次运行时系统可能提示来源未知。

* * *

> [!NOTE]

releases.name: 0.3.0 Experience Enhancement
releases.body:
## 升级须知

> [!CAUTION]
> **Android 务必先卸载旧版再安装。** 0.3.0 的备份位置和格式都变了，不再读取旧备份。
> 直接升级将导致旧备份永远保留在设备上。
> 卸载会清除应用数据和旧备份，需要重新添加游戏、关联设备并授权目录。

- **旧备份不能带到 0.3.0。** 如果还要用旧备份里的存档，请在升级前先恢复。
- 电脑端的旧备份不再显示，也不会自动清理，可以点备份页的“打开文件夹”手动删除。电脑端的备份开关和保留份数会恢复默认。
- 电脑端和移动端需要一起升级。
- Windows 只提供免安装版，未做代码签名，首次运行时可能出现 SmartScreen 提示。

## 新功能

- **传输时可以删除目标多出的文件。** 目标有来源没有的文件时，传输页会出现“保留/删除”开关。
- **备份可以直接管理。** 两端的备份都改成文件夹，按 `游戏名/UTC 时间` 存放。移动端放在 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/`，可以用能访问该目录的文件管理器查看和删除；电脑端可以从备份页打开文件夹。
- **备份页可以删除单份备份。** 备份页还会显示实际文件数和不完整备份的占用，并可以清理不完整的备份。
- **适配平板。** 屏幕最短边不小于 600dp 的设备支持横竖屏，主导航移到左上角，内容限制最大宽度，游戏列表按宽度增加列数。手机固定竖屏。
- **两端互看传输进度和结果。** 无论从哪一端发起，两端都能看到进度和逐项结果，也可以取消传输。每个游戏都能查看最近的传输。
- **写入中断提示。** 写入途中应用被关闭时，下次打开会提示文件可能不完整；有备份时可以直接跳到备份。
- **目录失效提示。** 目录被改名或授权失效时，游戏设置页的目录行会显示警告并提供“重新选择”。
- **开屏动画从后台返回时也会播放。** 回到桌面或切换应用后再打开都会播放。为了不闪过离开前的页面，Android 13 及以上的最近任务不再显示页面缩略图。

## 改进

- **移除游戏时会一并删除这个游戏的备份。**
- 启动时进入设备页；从后台返回时留在原页。
- 两端统一返回规则：返回到进入当前页之前的页面；传输详情返回游戏页。Android 返回键逐级返回，最后退出。
- 两端分别统一动效。移动端切页改成两页一起整屏平移，按钮和列表项使用相同的按下反馈；电脑端的列表项和卡片使用相同的悬停和按下效果。
- 移动端页面铺满系统栏，状态栏和页面背景连成一片，弹层遮罩也能盖住状态栏。
- 错误提示尽量写明出错的是电脑还是移动端。
- 比较结果过期后不再报错，会显示黄色提示并自动重新比较，确认后才开始传输。

releases.name: 0.2.0 UI Refactor
releases.body:
## 升级须知

- **Android 需要先卸载旧版再安装。** 0.2.0 起安装包改用固定发布密钥，无法覆盖安装 0.1.0、0.1.1。卸载会清除应用数据，需要重新添加游戏、关联设备并授权目录。
- 电脑端和手机端需要一起升级。
- Windows 只提供免安装版，未做代码签名，首次运行时可能出现 SmartScreen 提示。

## 新功能

- **双端界面重做。** 设备、游戏、任务、传输、备份和设置页换成同一套布局与视觉。各页面分离主次信息。
- **加入 i18n 支持。** 简中、繁中、英语、日语，默认跟随系统，也可以固定一种；Android 的通知会使用所选语言。
- **手动切换主题。** 跟随系统、浅色、深色，保存在本机。
- **备份份数可调。** 默认保留 3 份，可在 1 到 10 之间调整；每个游戏可以跟随全局，也可以单独设置。
- **Android 开屏动画。** 希望各位喜欢~

## 改进

- 手机传输页重新设计，高亮展示两端文件差异，按新增、减少、覆盖、保留等着色。
- 同步计划页顶部汇总文件操作数量，下方明细分组列出文件。
- 传输详情改成进度环加五步进度条，以及详细信息。
- 游戏设置页关联设备显示更直观了。
- 设置页重新设计 UI，更耐看了。
- 备份页显示当前策略和每次备份的时间线。

## 修复

- 修复自动备份存档时，只备份当次传输所变更的文件的问题。
- 修复清除系统浏览器数据可能造成应用数据丢失的问题（手机端的配置改到 Android 原生存储）。
- 修正文字选择、设备地址显示和启动失败时的提示。
- 修复路径显示分行的分割点。
- 修复不能覆盖安装更新 App 的问题（发布工作流使用固定密钥构建 APK）。

---

## Upgrade Notes

- **On Android, you must uninstall the old version before installing.** Starting with 0.2.0, the installer uses a fixed release key, so it cannot be installed over 0.1.0 or 0.1.1. Uninstalling will clear app data, so you will need to re-add games, link devices, and authorize directories.
- Desktop and mobile must be upgraded together.

releases.name: 0.1.1 E2E Expansion
releases.body:
## 升级须知

- 由于传输方式更改，电脑端和手机端要一起升级到 0.1.1。
- Android 可以直接覆盖安装 0.1.0，游戏、目录授权和备份都会保留。

## 新功能

- **在电脑上发起传输。** 在电脑的“传输存档”里选好方向，点“扫描并预览”，手机会扫描两端目录，把计划发回电脑。你在电脑上确认后，手机开始传输，完成后电脑显示“传输完成。”。手机 → 电脑、电脑 → 手机都可以。手机需要开着应用并连上电脑。

## 改进

- 两端改用 Websocket 连接。电脑浏览手机目录、发起传输都不用再等，手机目录打开就显示，不用手动刷新。
- 在电脑上修改游戏配置后，手机会马上同步更新。
- 手机关闭应用或断开连接时，电脑会立即提示。如果这时传输已经开始，会提示到任务列表查看结果。

## 修复

- 手机传输详情里，同一个文件的结果会重复出现，切换到其他页面后还会残留。

## 开发

- 桌面开发模式的页面服务改为监听 127.0.0.1 上的随机空闲端口。
- 在不搜索当前目录可执行文件的 shell 中（设置了 `NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath`），`pnpm android:build` 也能找到 Gradle Wrapper 了。

---

## Upgrade Notes

- The computer and phone must both be upgraded to 0.1.1. The connection method between the two ends has changed; 0.1.0 and 0.1.1 cannot connect to each other.
- On Android, you can install 0.1.1 directly over 0.1.0. Games, directory authorizations, and backups will be preserved.

## New Features

releases.name: Ryudeck v0.1.22
releases.body:
**New — Frame Generation (experimental)**
- **Frame Generation ships as an opt-in**: toggle it live in the Quick-Access blade (L3+R3) or per
  game in settings. It runs AMD FidelityFX optical-flow frame interpolation inside Ryudeck's own
  Vulkan present path — no external layers — presenting an interpolated frame between each pair of
  real frames on a dedicated present thread. GPU-light titles roughly double their perceived
  frame rate (measured on device: ~21-30 fps rendered → ~42-60 presented).
- It is self-limiting by design: generation only engages when it actually helps — it suspends below
  a per-title frame-rate floor, when the GPU has no spare headroom (measured from real per-frame GPU
  time, so misreported "100% busy" titles are handled), and when the game already runs near panel
  rate. A zero-delay dip veto skips generation for any single spiked frame (e.g. a shader-compile
  stall), so sudden hitches are never smeared into interpolated frames.
- Fixed: the feature now engages reliably on every launch (previously a first-launch state could
  latch process-wide), the blade reports its live state honestly (including a "restart game" hint

Automated build of `master` at d025537ac19570ab087ebd54fba226711da074df.

These are untested snapshots and may be broken. For stable builds use the [latest release](https://github.com/shanytc/snes9x/releases/latest).

**GUIs** (`super-snes9x-nightly-*`): Windows: unzip and run. Linux: `chmod +x` the AppImage. macOS: the app is universal (Intel + Apple Silicon) and self-signed, so after copying it run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine super-snes9x-qt.app`.

**libretro cores** (`supersnes9x_libretro-nightly-*`): unzip the core and its `.info` file into RetroArch's cores directory. The macOS core is a universal x86_64 + arm64 binary.

# Lua Scripting
- Added Lua 5.4 scripting: `File > Script > Lua` opens a script editor on win32, Qt and GTK, with syntax colouring, line numbers, completion, an API reference, a console and session restore.
- Added a script debugger: breakpoints (with conditions, hit counts and log messages), Step Into / Over / Out, Break on Errors, and Variables, Watch, Call Stack and Breakpoints panels.
- 28 example scripts under `Help > Examples`: FPS Counter, Sprite Boxes, RAM Heat Map, Input Display, Cheat Finder, Trace Logger and more.
- `-lua <script>` runs a script from the command line.
- `gui.set_antialias` smooths lines, circles, ellipses and polygons.
- No speed cost while no script is loaded.
- Guide and API reference: [Lua scripting](https://github.com/shanytc/snes9x/blob/master/docs/lua-scripting.md)

# Enhancement Chips (DSP-1/2/3/4, Cx4)
- DSP-1, DSP-1B, DSP-2, DSP-3, DSP-4 and the Cx4 now run as native chips that match their firmware instruction for instruction, with no dump needed.
- Each chip can also run its firmware dump (new BIOS Manager slots), or the old HLE.

# Nintendo Super System
- Added Nintendo Super System arcade support: Z80 supervisor, 
- key chip, on-screen display, three cartridge sockets and the front panel.
- Twelve of the thirteen dumped cartridges run, including HiROM and DSP-1 boards.
- Named the cartridge DIP switches for ActRaiser, The Addams Family, Lethal Weapon and Robocop 3.
- The supervisor's reset silences the APU too, Restart has to be held as on the cabinet, and nocash's test program is accepted as a BIOS.
- The joypad watchdog is off by default. Fixes Lethal Weapon being thrown off the machine.
- Added hotkey tabs
- Load with Preview now shows previews

# Nintendo Super Disc
- Added support for the BIOS in the BIOS Manager.
- Added support for disc insert and eject (eject resets to the home screen), and the disc's name in the window title.

- This mode runs a memory patched SGB2 BIOS with per-game in-memory patch to support colors and borders.
- Color now comes from the cart instead of the stale SGB palette. 
- Pre-palette fallback goes through BGP.
- DMG-compatibility color is routed through BGP/OBP.
- Carts whose SGB detect beats the Color branch get dedicated patches.
- Note: not all games might work out of the box - some issues might occur during game play / boot.

# Super Game Boy
- MLT_REQ is latched in the ICD2 instead of waiting for the BIOS.
- BIOS mode carries its cycle remainder instead of flooring twice, and deducts GB cycle overshoot (fixes audio pacing).
- Packet bits latch on the rising edge, not the falling one.
- MASK_EN honored on the BIOS pane, LCD-off treated as a freeze.
- Boot logo held on displayed content, hidden under the SGB BIOS, and shown only when a boot ROM was actually assigned.

releases.body:
# WinLite v1.4.0

## Overview
A release focused on rendering smoothness, a new X11 server and Steam support.

---

## 🎮 BETA - Steam
- Steam client support added.

---

## 🖥️ X11 server (rewritten in Rust)
The built-in X server has been rewritten from scratch in Rust and now covers much more of the X11 protocol.

**What you get**
- **Stability.** Memory-safe code removes a whole class of crashes and hangs.
- **Better game and launcher compatibility.** Newer screen-configuration (RANDR 1.2) and rendering extensions are supported, so Wine, launchers and games see a more complete environment.
- **Proper mouse cursors.** System cursors are drawn from a built-in cursor set, and colored/semi-transparent and animated cursors are supported.
- **Better frame pacing.** Frame presentation is synchronized with the real display refresh rate and with fences, which gives the renderer and the FPS limiter an accurate clock to work from.
- **Faster window drawing.** The shared frame buffer is locked once per operation instead of repeatedly, and more drawing requests (lines, rectangles, area clears) are handled directly.

releases.body:
Faster graphics code and more robust memory handling for the game's draw commands.

## English

**Improvements**
- The graphics translation code is now built with stronger optimizations. This mainly helps phones where it limits the frame rate (MediaTek / Mali, mid-range Snapdragon).
- More robust handling of the game's draw-command memory: the game no longer closes when a heavy scene or menu runs out of it.

**Install:** update the APK over the old one, your saves stay. No need to re-run setup. New install: prepare the game folder with setup from this repository (base game + update v327680 + prod.keys, see docs/INSTALL.md), copy Torchlight2Mobile to the phone's Download folder, install the APK. Android 10 or 11: `Torchlight2-Mobile-v0.1.4-arm64-android10.apk`.

## Русский

**Улучшения**
- Код перевода графики теперь собирается с более сильной оптимизацией. В основном это поможет телефонам, где он ограничивает частоту кадров (MediaTek / Mali, Snapdragon среднего класса).
- Надёжнее работа с памятью команд отрисовки: игра больше не закрывается, если тяжёлой сцене или меню её не хватило.

releases.name: v0.1.3
releases.body:
Graphics fixes for PowerVR GPUs and the safe graphics mode, and no more strip at the camera cutout.

## English

**Fixes**
- Fixed characters stretching into spikes and floor tiles breaking apart on PowerVR GPUs (and in the safe graphics mode on other GPUs).
- Fixed objects that could briefly use another object's textures in the same cases.
- Adreno phones with the default settings are not affected by the two fixes above.
- Fixed a black strip at the camera cutout on some phones (e.g. MIUI 13 / Android 12); the game now fills the whole screen.

**Install:** update the APK over the old one, your saves stay. No need to re-run setup. New install: prepare the game folder with setup from this repository (base game + update v327680 + prod.keys, see docs/INSTALL.md), copy Torchlight2Mobile to the phone's Download folder, install the APK. Android 10 or 11: `Torchlight2-Mobile-v0.1.3-arm64-android10.apk`.

## Русский

**Исправления**
- Исправлено: на видеочипах PowerVR (и в безопасном графическом режиме на других) персонажи вытягивались в шипы, а плитки пола разлетались.
- Исправлено: в тех же случаях объекты могли ненадолго брать чужие текстуры.

Local multiplayer over Wi-Fi between phones, and a new launcher icon.

## English

**Local multiplayer**
- The game's own local wireless play now works between phones on the same Wi-Fi network or the same hotspot.
- Host: **+** → multiplayer → local network game → create a local game → start the game.
- Join: the same menu → join a local game → pick the game from the list.
- Every player needs the same version of the app and their own prepared game folder.
- On by default; gear → *Local wireless play over Wi-Fi* turns it off. Nothing is opened on the network until you host or look for a local game.
- Tested with two phones (host + client) on one Wi-Fi network.

**Other**
- New launcher icon.

**Install:** update the APK over the old one, your saves stay. New install: prepare the game folder with setup from this repository (base game + update v327680 + prod.keys, see docs/INSTALL.md), copy Torchlight2Mobile to the phone's Download folder, install the APK. releases.name: v0.1.1
releases.body:
Mods now really override the game, a weapon swap button, tappable character creation and smoother play.

## English

**PC mods**
- The mod manager moved to the pause menu (gear → *Mods…*).
- Mods now override the game's own files (outfits, textures, models), and a mod lower in the list overrides the ones above it.
- After you enable, disable or reorder mods, the game offers to restart right away.
- Tested with a texture mod and two new playable classes (Cacklespit, Werewolf).

**Controls**
- New ⇄ button (top right, next to L3) swaps your weapon sets in the field. In the side layout it is the ← cell.
- Character creation: the arrows for class, look, pet and difficulty work by tap.
- Fixed a crash when changing gender for classes that have only one body type (e.g. modded classes).
- The touch controls redraw only when something changes: less work for the phone while a finger is on the screen.
- New launcher icon.

**Performance**
- The game's background worker threads no longer wake the CPU tens of thousands of times a second while idle: lower CPU load and less heat.

### Changes

- Added native implementations of selected game, rendering, AI and container algorithms, with the original recompiled paths retained. Optimized guest-register handling, x87 calculations and indirect-call caches.

Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.4.1-dev (versionCode 8).

### Changes

- Improved CPU performance on PhysX Mod Pack maps with native fluid collision kernels, native pair removal and optimized x87 calculations.
- Added on-device HLSL compilation through vkd3d-shader, with shader caching and improved MojoShader compatibility for mod materials.
- Fixed touch aiming: holding Fire no longer blocks another finger's camera movement; dragging from Fire, secondary fire, Jump or Crouch also turns the camera.
- Made the crash monitor a launcher option, disabled by default, to avoid keeping its extra Android process running unless needed.
- Removed FSR3 frame generation. FSR1 spatial upscaling and FXAA remain available.
- Reduced per-draw post-processing overhead and removed temporary qa-flags performance switches.
- Updated localized PhysX and audio setting descriptions.

### Installation and validation

Requires Android 11+ on ARM64 and your own files from the Steam version of the game. DXVK requires Vulkan 1.3; compatible Adreno devices can use Turnip.

Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.4-dev.

### Changes

- Added an FPS counter with a frame-time graph and optional system information for every renderer.
- Added FSR1, FXAA, and FSR3.1 frame generation (DXVK, Android 12+; disabled by default).
- Added CPU-based PhysX effects and OpenAL Soft audio through AAudio with EAX 1–5 support.
- Added a maximum-graphics button and fixed persistence of the 3D rendering scale.
- Fixed terrain rendering in OpenGL ES, accelerated DXT decoding, and allowed unused texture mip levels to stream out.
- Improved GPU query handling in GLES and DXVK, including on PowerVR devices.
- Fixed ASTC/ETC2 texture conversion on shared storage on Pixel devices.
- Added a “Firing or aiming” gyroscope mode and persistent crash reports with a separate error window.

### Installation and limitations

Requires Android 11+ on ARM64 and your own files from the Steam version of the game. DXVK requires Vulkan 1.3; frame generation requires Android 12+. Frame generation may cause HUD artifacts and adds GPU and memory overhead. A stable 60 FPS at maximum graphics settings is not guaranteed.

The third release of the native Android ARM64 port of Unreal Tournament 3 improves GLES performance, text editing and graphics cache handling.

### Changes

- Added a dedicated GLES render thread with automatic CPU core selection. Streamed draw uploads, asynchronous query polling and shader program prelinking reduce work on the game thread.
- Added driver-aware graphics cache maintenance: GLES program binaries are invalidated after driver changes, and DXVK keeps the current and newest other pipeline cache for each driver.
- Fixed DXVK scaled vertex formats with a shader fallback for drivers that need it.
- Replaced keyboard-only text entry with an Android editing dialog for game fields, console commands and chat. Existing text can be corrected or cleared; cancellation preserves it, and original character filters remain in effect.
- Added separate weapon-button swipe settings and expanded the in-game Android settings to nine languages: English, Russian, Czech, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian and Polish.
- Improved launcher texture status and fixed texture handling, audio and FSINCOS translation. Expanded regression tests and rendering diagnostics.

### Requirements

Новая подсистема порта: решает, сколько потоков работает, как главные потоки ждут друг друга, на каких ядрах

releases.name: v11.5
releases.body:
## v11.5 摘要

**批量 / 扫描导入** — 导入向导第一步新增「批量扫描导入（多选）」：选一个目录（例如 Download），用 SAF 扫出候选——顶层带 `.exe` / `.rpy` / `.rpyc` / `.xp3` / `.rpa` / `.ypf` / `.wolf` / `.rgssad` / `.nsa` 之一，或是 Ren'Py 的 `game/` 目录；套娃目录只下探一层，跳过隐藏目录与运行时目录。勾选后**串行**导入，每条独立汇报「等待 / 复制中 / 导入中 / 已导入 / 失败」，失败项复用单条导入的回滚（删已建容器根目录 + 清暂存）。批量**不**自动拉起内置引擎，导完统一回游戏库自己点。

**分类过滤由「单选」升级为「三维组合」** — 引擎 + 品类 + 标签可同时生效（AND），同一维度再点一次取消；筛空时空态文案改为「没有匹配的游戏」。「继续游玩」改为按最后启动时间倒序且只收真启动过的（`lastPlayedAt > 0`）——此前是「列表前 3 个」，名不副实；没玩过任何游戏时整段隐藏。

**封面（提取修复 + 用户自定义）** — ①`BitmapFactory` 解不了 PE 资源里的原始 DIB，所以卡片封面一直是占位图；新增 `IconCodec` 兜底（补 14 字节 `BITMAPFILEHEADER`、`biHeight` 减半剥掉 AND 掩码层、按 8bpp 调色板算偏移），组内候选按字节数降序逐个重试——真机上那款 Unity 游戏的 exe 图标首次正常显示。②详情页「维护 → 封面」可**从相册选图**或**恢复自动**，优先级 自定义 > 目录图 > exe 图标；选图先落 `.tmp` 并实际解码一次，解不开的不落盘。③修「换完封面回列表仍显示占位图」：解码完成前同一位置可能已被重绑到另一个 View，旧逻辑只贴给回调持有者；现在解码完成后让列表按缓存位图重画一次。

**UI 修正（真机实测出来的）** — 多选条加「品类 / 标签」后，六个动作把「已选 N 项」挤成 0 宽、「完成」被截断：标签简化为「删除 / 移除」、收紧边距、计数给最小宽度，全部回到一行内。「彻底删除 / 仅移除」确认弹窗从**只报数量**改为**列出游戏名**，并写明原生游戏的收纳副本同样会被删（真机复验时因只报数量误删过一批，当场从仍在的源目录重新导入恢复）。

releases.name: v11.4
releases.body:
## v11.4 摘要

**导入重做** — 第一步从「手输路径」换成系统文件夹选择器（`ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE` + persistable 授权），授权跟目录走、不随卸载重装重置；所选目录先复制进应用私有暂存（带进度、失败清半成品、可用空间 <128MB 硬失败、6h 残骸清扫）再走原管线。

**导入假成功链（真机事故 D1–D5）** — 重装后「所有文件访问」被系统重置时 `listFiles()` 为 null，旧行为一路「成功」到启动才报「启动文件缺失」：现 step0 fail-fast 并带用户去授权页。同批修复：解压套娃目录归一（`resolveGameRoot`，JVM 回归 E15–E21）、库条目回填标题/引擎、CJK 目录名塌缩改附哈希后缀、容器名恒等 `galgame-<gameId>`（避让上移到 id 派生）、导入失败回滚已建容器、复制完成无 exe 当场告警、重复导入先确认。

**游戏库分类** — 顶部 chips 单选过滤：引擎自动归类（多于一种才出现）、预置内容品类（视觉小说 / 文字冒险 / 其他）、自定义标签；长按多选后「品类 / 标签」可一次给多张卡归类，标签可内联新建。

**数据安全三件** — ①「彻底删除」补删 `files/galgame-native` 收纳副本（此前数 GB 静默泄漏）并校验结果；②索引改 `.tmp`+`fsync`+rename 原子写，解析失败先隔离 `.corrupt-<ts>` 再重建；③存档管理器拒绝空 gameId（跨游戏串档），便携存档「先搬后链」改为合并不完整就不删源、链接失败把档拷回、同名冲突留 `.bak`。

**运维事实（重要）** — 卸载重装 / 清数据会重置全部文件权限（含「所有文件访问」），ColorOS/Android 16 上 shell 无法代授，只能用户手动开；新的导入流程不依赖该权限。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包 11.4：选择器全链路（Download → 游戏目录 → 使用此文件夹）→ 检测 UNITY / 5 个文件 → 导入 → 单卡启动 → 标题菜单 → 正片连续推进对白 100s+；分类三条链路（品类/标签/引擎 chips，筛选取值 1/1/2）；把索引写成非法 JSON 后改一次分类 → 旧文件留档、新索引字段正确；注入 2MB 收纳副本后彻底删除 → 目录归空。

releases.name: v11.3
releases.body:
## v11.3 摘要

**界面** — Swiss 单首页 IA 与全站视觉重构：内页与游戏内 UI 收进同一套视觉语言；明暗双档走同一套主题 token（`values-night` 反相，状态栏图标随档位切换）；「设置 → 输入控制」从死路接成真入口；运行环境可管理（详情 / 重新注入语言字体 / 删除）。

**引擎** — 指纹扩展到 **19 个**（Siglus / YU-RIS / Artemis / CatSystem2 / AdvHD / SystemNNN / BGI / CMVS / Unity 等）；新增 `detectDeep()` 有限深度下钻（深度 ≤3、预算 4000 项），修子目录 `.xp3` 被判 UNKNOWN 后无法升级路由的问题。

**稳定性** — 修复 X server 输出流的静默截断与 SIGPIPE：`XOutputStream_send` 由裸阻塞 `write()` 改为 `send(MSG_NOSIGNAL)` 循环写满，EINTR 重试、EAGAIN 时 `poll` 上限 2 秒。

**工程** — box64 自建变成可复现资产（私有补丁导出 + 双向校验 + 构建脚本 + 打包器入库，版本不再写死）；类型门禁修绿（热点清单 3 → 6 条、`R` 桩 100 → 183 符号）；运行时资源 SHA-256 清单补齐 `assets` 子目录（34 → 57 个文件）。

**已知限制** — 走 DirectShow 的引擎（SystemNNN / YU-RIS 等）过场动画仍黑屏。根因已定位到 Wine 内建 quartz 的 `IVideoWindow::put_WindowStyle` → `SetWindowPos` 跨线程 `SendMessage` 永不返回（`IMediaControl::Run` 从未被调用），属 Wine 侧问题、应用层不可改，登记为 TD-09。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包：库页 19 条正常、详情页与设置页正常、版本号显示 11.3、锚点《花瓣！》`HANA9cn.EXE` 经 UI 完整路径启动并渲染标题画面。

逐条变更与提交号见仓库 [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/ReSerendipity/GalgameShell/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。下面自动生成的 PR 列表只覆盖经过 PR 合并的条目，直接推送到 `main` 的提交不在其中。

---
